title: "Executable T chunks"
filters:
  - tlang
engine: markdown
---

# Simple example

```{t}
values = [1, 2, 3, 4]
```

```{t}
mean(values)
```

# Chunk options

```{t}
#| echo: false
text_summary = "This chunk still runs, but its source is hidden."
```

```{t}
text_summary
```

# Highlighting

```{t}
#| eval: false
-- T code is highlighted, just like R.
palette = ["red", "green", "blue"]
ratio = 0.5
mean([1, 2, 3, 4])
```
